mentions.name: SF Permacomputing Club
mentions.description: A San Francisco community club focused on permacomputing—long-lasting, community-driven technology—co-hosting events and conversations around sustainable tech.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Just today I helped co-host the SF Permacomputing Club.

It was a lot of fun and I love all the good energy people bring to the conversation about long lasting and community driven tech.
